# Suggested GitHub labels

Create these labels when the repository is set up (Settings, Labels).

| Label | Use for |
| --- | --- |
| `good first issue` | Small, well-scoped tasks for new contributors |
| `help wanted` | Work maintainers would like help with |
| `enhancement` | New features or improvements |
| `bug` | Something that does not work as documented |
| `documentation` | Docs fixes and additions |
| `research` | Open questions that need investigation before implementation |
